title: 17 Day Albertine Rift Birding Safari
rank_math_title: Albertine Rift Birding Safari: 17 Amazing Days in Uganda
rank_math_desc: Albertine Rift birding safari for 17 days in Uganda: Kibale, Semliki, Rwenzori, Queen Elizabeth and Bwindi, with a gorilla trek. Price on request.
post_content: This Albertine Rift birding safari targets Uganda's rarest birds, from Congo Basin forest specials at Semliki to the endemics of Bwindi and Ruhija.
overview:
This Albertine Rift birding safari is a 17-day journey through western Uganda for birders who want the region's endemics and forest specials. It also includes chimpanzee tracking and a mountain gorilla trek.

The Albertine Rift runs along Uganda's border with Congo and Rwanda. Its mountain forests hold dozens of birds found nowhere else, and Semliki adds species from the great Congo Basin rainforest.

Why choose this Albertine Rift birding safari?

  • Kibale: green-breasted pitta, forest robins and chimpanzees.
  • Semliki: Congo Basin hornbills, Nkulengu rail and Congo serpent eagle.
  • Rwenzori foothills: crimsonwings and purple-breasted sunbird.
  • Queen Elizabeth: Kazinga Channel boat trip, skimmers and black bee-eaters.
  • Bwindi and Ruhija: African green broadbill, Rwenzori turaco and mountain gorillas.

Where you stay

Lodges include Lindsay Cottages in Entebbe, Ndali Lodge near Kibale, Semliki Safari Lodge, Margherita Hotel in Kasese, Mweya Safari Lodge, Buhoma Homestead or Gorilla Forest Camp, and Trekker's Tavern at Ruhija, or similar.

The Mubwindi Swamp walk

From Ruhija, a steep trail drops to Mubwindi Swamp, the best site in Uganda for the rare African green broadbill. It is a demanding walk, but a highlight for serious birders.

Best time for an Albertine Rift birding safari

Birding is good all year. The drier months, June to August and December to February, make forest trails easier. March to May and October to November are wetter, but many birds are breeding and singing.

Read our Bwindi gorilla trekking guide and guide to Uganda national parks, or browse all birding safaris. Park rules and permits are managed by the Uganda Wildlife Authority.

faq.a: Yes. One gorilla permit per person is included. Chimpanzee tracking in Kibale is optional and can be added.

faq.q: How difficult are the forest walks?
faq.a: Most trails are moderate. The Mubwindi Swamp trail at Ruhija is steep and can be muddy, so good fitness helps.

itinerary.label: Day 1
itinerary.title: Arrival in Entebbe
itinerary.content: Meet your birding guide at Entebbe Airport and transfer to Lindsay Cottages. Early arrivals can bird the Entebbe Botanical Gardens.

itinerary.label: Day 2
itinerary.title: Entebbe to Kibale National Park
itinerary.content: An early start west to Kibale, birding along the way. Check in at Ndali Lodge or similar.

itinerary.label: Day 3
itinerary.title: Kibale Forest
itinerary.content: Morning in the forest for green-breasted pitta, forest robins and barbets, with optional chimpanzee tracking. Afternoon birding along the main road through the forest.

itinerary.label: Day 4
itinerary.title: Kibale to Semliki
itinerary.content: Drive to Semliki National Park, a lowland forest linked to the Congo Basin. Overnight at Semliki Safari Lodge.

itinerary.label: Day 5
itinerary.title: Kirumia Trail, Semliki
itinerary.content: A full day on the Kirumia Trail with a packed lunch, searching for hornbills, kingfishers, malimbes and honeyguides.

itinerary.label: Day 6
itinerary.title: Semliki to Kasese
itinerary.content: Morning birding in Semliki, then drive to Kasese at the foot of the Rwenzori Mountains. Overnight at Margherita Hotel.

itinerary.label: Day 7
itinerary.title: Rwenzori foothills
itinerary.content: A full day birding the lower slopes of the Rwenzoris for crimsonwings, sunbirds and forest flycatchers.

itinerary.label: Day 8
itinerary.title: Queen Elizabeth National Park
itinerary.content: Drive into Queen Elizabeth National Park for savannah and wetland birds. Overnight at Mweya Safari Lodge.

itinerary.label: Day 9
itinerary.title: Kazinga Channel
itinerary.content: Morning game drive, then a two-hour afternoon boat trip on the Kazinga Channel for skimmers, storks, kingfishers and hippos.

itinerary.label: Day 10
itinerary.title: Queen Elizabeth to Bwindi
itinerary.content: Drive south, optionally through the Ishasha sector, to Buhoma in Bwindi. Bird the Munyaga trail if time allows.

itinerary.label: Day 11
itinerary.title: Bwindi, Buhoma section
itinerary.content: A full day on the forest trails for Albertine Rift endemics, turacos and greenbuls.

itinerary.label: Day 12
itinerary.title: Gorilla trekking
itinerary.content: Briefing at park headquarters, then track a habituated gorilla family and spend one hour with them. Packed lunch.

itinerary.label: Day 13
itinerary.title: The Neck to Ruhija
itinerary.content: Bird the road through the 'Neck', a lush valley full of forest birds, and continue up to Ruhija. Overnight at Trekker's Tavern or similar.

itinerary.label: Day 14
itinerary.title: Mubwindi Swamp
itinerary.content: A full day on the trail down to Mubwindi Swamp for African green broadbill, Grauer's warbler and other endemics.

itinerary.label: Day 15
itinerary.title: Ruhija bamboo zone
itinerary.content: Bird the bamboo and montane forest along the main road for highland endemics.

itinerary.label: Day 16
itinerary.title: Return to Entebbe
itinerary.content: A long drive back to Entebbe with birding stops. Overnight at Lindsay Cottages or Lake Victoria Hotel.

itinerary.label: Day 17
itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.content: Transfer to Entebbe Airport for your flight.
